sql: WITH r AS (SELECT referee, COUNT(*) AS nb_matchs FROM sb.matches WHERE referee IS NOT NULL GROUP BY referee) SELECT referee, nb_matchs FROM r WHERE nb_matchs = (SELECT MAX(nb_matchs) FROM r)

WITH g AS (SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, e.match_id, e.period, e.minute, e.second, e.minute * 60 + e.second AS secondes FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <= 4) SELECT player_name, team_name, match_id, minute, second, secondes AS secondes_depuis_coup_envoi FROM g WHERE secondes = (SELECT MIN(secondes) FROM g)

WITH b AS (SELECT pl.player_name, t.team_name, s.statsbomb_xg, e.match_id, e.minute FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON pl.player_id = e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5) SELECT player_name, team_name, statsbomb_xg, match_id, minute FROM b WHERE statsbomb_xg = (SELECT MIN(statsbomb_xg) FROM b)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) AS nb_buteurs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_direct_coup_franc FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Free Kick' AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5

SELECT t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = t.team_id THEN m.home_score ELSE m.away_score END) AS buts_marques FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) WHERE t.team_name = 'France' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_prolongations FROM (SELECT e.event_id FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period IN (3, 4) UNION ALL SELECT event_id FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Own Goal For' AND period IN (3, 4)) g

SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_temps_additionnel_2e_periode FROM (SELECT e.event_id FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period = 2 AND e.minute >= 90 UNION ALL SELECT e.event_id FROM sb.events e WHERE e.type = 'Own Goal Against' AND e.period = 2 AND e.minute >= 90) g
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_de_la_tete FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.body_part = 'Head' AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5
SELECT SUM(home_score + away_score) AS buts_total FROM sb.matches
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cartons_jaunes FROM sb.events e WHERE e.type IN ('Foul Committed', 'Bad Behaviour') AND COALESCE(e.details->'card'->>'name', e.details->>'card') = 'Yellow Card'

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS centres FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE ps.is_cross AND t.team_name = 'England' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name

SELECT p.player_name, SUM(s.statsbomb_xg) AS xg_cumule FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE e.period < 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY xg_cumule DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 5

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS corners FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE ps.pass_type = 'Corner' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, corners FROM c WHERE corners = (SELECT MAX(corners) FROM c)

WITH r AS (SELECT t.team_name, AVG(CASE WHEN p.reached_final_third THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS proportion_dernier_tiers, COUNT(*) AS nb_possessions FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = p.team_id WHERE p.period < 5 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, proportion_dernier_tiers, nb_possessions FROM r WHERE proportion_dernier_tiers = (SELECT MAX(proportion_dernier_tiers) FROM r)

WITH d AS (SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS dribbles_reussis FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE e.type = 'Dribble' AND COALESCE(e.details->'outcome'->>'name', e.details->>'outcome', e.details->'dribble'->'outcome'->>'name') = 'Complete' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT player_name, dribbles_reussis FROM d WHERE dribbles_reussis = (SELECT MAX(dribbles_reussis) FROM d)
SELECT AVG(duration_seconds) AS duree_moyenne_secondes FROM sb.possessions WHERE period < 5

WITH x AS (SELECT t.team_name, SUM(s.statsbomb_xg) AS xg_total FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.period < 5 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, xg_total FROM x WHERE xg_total = (SELECT MAX(xg_total) FROM x)

WITH f AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS fautes FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Foul Committed' GROUP BY team_id), mj AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS matchs FROM (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id FROM sb.matches) x GROUP BY team_id), r AS (SELECT f.team_id, f.fautes, mj.matchs, f.fautes::numeric / mj.matchs AS fautes_par_match FROM f JOIN mj ON mj.team_id = f.team_id) SELECT t.team_name, r.fautes, r.matchs, r.fautes_par_match FROM r JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = r.team_id WHERE r.fautes_par_match = (SELECT MAX(fautes_par_match) FROM r)
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS fautes_commises FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.type = 'Foul Committed' AND t.team_name = 'Uruguay' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name

SELECT DISTINCT pl.player_name, t.team_name, e.match_id, e.type FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players pl ON pl.player_id = e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.type IN ('Foul Committed', 'Bad Behaviour') AND (e.details::text ILIKE '%Red Card%' OR e.details::text ILIKE '%Second Yellow%') ORDER BY pl.player_name

WITH m AS (SELECT mt.match_id, mt.match_date, mt.stage, h.team_name AS equipe_domicile, a.team_name AS equipe_exterieur, mt.home_score, mt.away_score, mt.home_score + mt.away_score AS total_buts FROM sb.matches mt JOIN sb.teams h ON h.team_id = mt.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams a ON a.team_id = mt.away_team_id) SELECT * FROM m WHERE total_buts = (SELECT MAX(total_buts) FROM m)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matchs_croatie FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) WHERE t.team_name = 'Croatia'

interpretation: score final egal, tirs au but compris
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_matchs_nuls FROM sb.matches WHERE home_score = away_score

WITH b AS (SELECT pl.player_name, COUNT(*) AS buts FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON pl.player_id = e.player_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, buts FROM b WHERE buts = (SELECT MAX(buts) FROM b)

WITH a AS (SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_decisives FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE ps.goal_assist GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT player_name, passes_decisives FROM a WHERE passes_decisives = (SELECT MAX(passes_decisives) FROM a)

WITH p AS (SELECT e.team_id, COUNT(*) AS tentees, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pa.outcome IS NULL OR pa.outcome = 'Complete') AS reussies FROM sb.passes pa JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = pa.event_id GROUP BY e.team_id), r AS (SELECT team_id, tentees, reussies, reussies::numeric / tentees AS taux_reussite FROM p) SELECT t.team_name, r.tentees, r.reussies, r.taux_reussite FROM r JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = r.team_id WHERE r.taux_reussite = (SELECT MAX(taux_reussite) FROM r)

WITH t AS (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, away_score AS encaisses FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, home_score FROM sb.matches), a AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(encaisses) AS buts_encaisses, COUNT(*) AS matchs, SUM(encaisses)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS encaisses_par_match FROM t GROUP BY team_id) SELECT tm.team_name, a.buts_encaisses, a.matchs, a.encaisses_par_match FROM a JOIN sb.teams tm ON tm.team_id = a.team_id WHERE a.encaisses_par_match = (SELECT MIN(encaisses_par_match) FROM a)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_contre_son_camp FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Own Goal Against'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_matchs FROM sb.matches
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_remplacements FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Substitution'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matchs_aux_tirs_au_but FROM sb.events WHERE period = 5

WITH g AS (SELECT e.period FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5 UNION ALL SELECT period FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Own Goal For' AND period < 5) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 1) AS buts_premiere_periode, COUNT(*) AS buts_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 1)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS part_premiere_periode FROM g

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_decisives FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%Eden Hazard%' AND ps.goal_assist GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name

SELECT pl.player_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_decisives FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = p.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON pl.player_id = e.player_id WHERE p.goal_assist AND pl.player_name ILIKE '%Hazard%' GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name ORDER BY passes_decisives DESC

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_reussies FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE p.player_name ILIKE 'Luka Modri%' AND ps.outcome IS NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS passes_en_profondeur_reussies FROM sb.passes WHERE is_through_ball AND (outcome IS NULL OR outcome = 'Complete')

WITH c AS (SELECT pl.player_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_reussies FROM sb.passes pa JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = pa.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON pl.player_id = e.player_id WHERE pa.outcome IS NULL OR pa.outcome = 'Complete' GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, passes_reussies FROM c WHERE passes_reussies = (SELECT MAX(passes_reussies) FROM c)

WITH b AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) AS nb_buteurs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, nb_buteurs FROM b WHERE nb_buteurs = (SELECT MAX(nb_buteurs) FROM b)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS penalties_en_match FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Penalty' AND e.period < 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS penalties_transformes FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Penalty' AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5

WITH t AS (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, away_score AS encaisses FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, home_score FROM sb.matches), a AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(encaisses) AS buts_encaisses FROM t GROUP BY team_id) SELECT tm.team_name, a.buts_encaisses FROM a JOIN sb.teams tm ON tm.team_id = a.team_id WHERE a.buts_encaisses = (SELECT MAX(buts_encaisses) FROM a)

interpretation: part moyenne du temps de possession par match
sql: WITH pm AS (SELECT match_id, team_id, SUM(duration_seconds) AS d FROM sb.possessions WHERE period < 5 GROUP BY match_id, team_id), pt AS (SELECT match_id, team_id, d, SUM(d) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id) AS tot FROM pm), agg AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(d)::numeric / SUM(tot) AS part_possession, SUM(d) AS secondes_possession FROM pt GROUP BY team_id) SELECT t.team_name, agg.part_possession, agg.secondes_possession FROM agg JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = agg.team_id WHERE agg.part_possession = (SELECT MAX(part_possession) FROM agg)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS possessions_belges_avec_tir FROM sb.possessions po JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = po.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Belgium' AND po.produced_shot AND po.period < 5

WITH g AS (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, home_score AS gf, away_score AS ga FROM sb.matches WHERE stage ILIKE 'Group%' UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, away_score, home_score FROM sb.matches WHERE stage ILIKE 'Group%'), s AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gf > ga) AS victoires FROM g GROUP BY team_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_equipes_sans_victoire FROM s WHERE victoires = 0
SELECT m.stadium, m.stadium_country, m.match_date FROM sb.matches m WHERE m.stage = 'Final'

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved', 'Saved to Post')) AS tirs_cadres, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved', 'Saved to Post')) / COUNT(*) AS pourcentage_cadres FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'France' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_tentees, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.outcome IS NULL) AS passes_reussies, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.outcome IS NULL)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS taux_reussite FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Spain' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name

WITH c AS (SELECT pl.player_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs_cadres FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON pl.player_id = e.player_id WHERE e.period < 5 AND lower(s.outcome) IN ('goal', 'saved', 'saved to post') GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, tirs_cadres FROM c WHERE tirs_cadres = (SELECT MAX(tirs_cadres) FROM c)

WITH c AS (SELECT CASE WHEN e.team_id = m.home_team_id THEN m.away_team_id ELSE m.home_team_id END AS team_id, COUNT(*) AS tirs_concedes FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = e.match_id WHERE e.period < 5 GROUP BY 1) SELECT t.team_name, c.tirs_concedes FROM c JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE c.tirs_concedes = (SELECT MAX(tirs_concedes) FROM c)

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Croatia' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = e.match_id WHERE m.stage = 'Final'

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs_hors_surface FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.loc_x IS NOT NULL AND e.loc_y IS NOT NULL AND NOT (e.loc_x >= 102 AND e.loc_y BETWEEN 18 AND 62) GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, tirs_hors_surface FROM c WHERE tirs_hors_surface = (SELECT MAX(tirs_hors_surface) FROM c)

SELECT pl.player_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON pl.player_id = e.player_id WHERE pl.player_name ILIKE '%Mbapp%' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name
SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sb.matches) AS tirs_par_match FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE e.period < 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (l.elem -> 'player' ->> 'id')::int) AS joueurs_differents_onze_depart FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.details -> 'tactics' -> 'lineup') AS l(elem) WHERE e.type = 'Starting XI' AND t.team_name = 'France'

SELECT t.team_name AS vainqueur, m.home_score, m.away_score FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = CASE WHEN m.home_score > m.away_score THEN m.home_team_id ELSE m.away_team_id END WHERE m.stage ILIKE 'final'

WITH so AS (SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal') AS buts FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE e.period = 5 GROUP BY e.match_id, e.team_id), w AS (SELECT match_id, team_id, buts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY buts DESC) AS rk FROM so) SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS seances_gagnees FROM w JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = w.team_id WHERE w.rk = 1 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY seances_gagnees DESC, t.team_name

WITH russia AS (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Russia'), m AS (SELECT m.match_id, r.team_id, CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = r.team_id THEN m.home_score ELSE m.away_score END AS gf, CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = r.team_id THEN m.away_score ELSE m.home_score END AS ga FROM sb.matches m JOIN russia r ON r.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id)), pen AS (SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal') AS g FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.period = 5 GROUP BY e.match_id, e.team_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.gf > m.ga) AS victoires_au_score, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.gf = m.ga AND COALESCE(pm.g, 0) > COALESCE(po.g, 0)) AS victoires_aux_tirs_au_but FROM m LEFT JOIN pen pm ON pm.match_id = m.match_id AND pm.team_id = m.team_id LEFT JOIN pen po ON po.match_id = m.match_id AND po.team_id <> m.team_id
